pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pCombines dirty-circuit cleaning and damaged-circuit repair in one machine.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place a Dirty or Damaged circuit in the process input.$p2. Check that the corresponding server recipe is present.$p3. Provide full batch energy and clear output slots.$p4. Move the resulting clean board into the analyser.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pA clean/already analysed board is not the dirty/damaged input this chamber expects.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
